messages:
maria: FYI during int4 bring-up I hit a repeatable token-drop in qwen-7b after running the new converter. Seems like a packer wrap.
ben: Example?
maria: Prompt: 'List three US states starting with A' -> gemma returns 'Alabama, Alaska, Arizona' but qwen sometimes gives 'Alabama, �, Alaska, Arizona' after conversion.
alex: � indicates id 0. Could be overflow into a 16-bit slot or accidental remap. Did you diff token ids pre/post-conversion?
maria: Yes. Minimal repro:
```
gemma ids: [154,203,11,412]
converted qwen ids: [154,203,0,412]
```
The map entry had `11 -> 65536`. Our packer stores into uint16 and 65536 -> 0.
ben: Which tool produced the map? tools/tokenmap/packer.py?
maria: tools/tokenmap/packmap.py in the conversion pipeline. The packer masks to 0xFFFF but then casts somewhere as uint16.
ci-bot: Conversion job #452 completed 2026-03-18T09:12:04Z (artifact: qwen-gemma-int4.map).
sasha: Quick diff: contiguous run of mappings above 65520 wrapped to small ids. Looks like the packer doesn't validate ranges.
pranav: I ran the 1k eval set (open-qa + summarization). Token-drop rate for qwen-int4 jumped from 0.4% -> 2.7% with the new map. Gemma unaffected.
ben: That's large. Immediate mitigation?
maria: Plan: 1) revert the bad map in S3, 2) add a guard in packmap to reject mapped ids >= 65536, 3) add unit test and run A/B.
ben: I can revert. Maria add the test + guard. Also add a conversion-audit that prints max_mapped_id.
alex: Also double-check KV-cache code: it assumes 16-bit token slots for our int4 kernels. Document that invariant or change layout.
sasha: I'll grep repo for other packers using uint16 and flag copy/paste issues.
ci-bot: Restorer action: artifact qwen-gemma-int4.map rolled back to v20260310 (actor: ben).
maria: After rollback remap_ids returns expected [154,203,11,412] and A/B weirdness back to ~0.45%.
pranav: Note: re-encoding maps caused a tiny p50 latency blip (~0.5%) when we pushed the broken map. Might be unrelated but monitor.
ben: Filed follow-up ticket to evaluate long-term approaches: keep 32-bit slots vs split vocab or an indirection table.
sasha: Added quick grep results: 3 files packer/* reference uint16 without bounds checks. Will open PRs.
maria: Opening PR to add guard + failing test and a small smoke harness that runs three canonical prompts across converted artifacts.
alex: Good. After PR lands let's add conversion gate: block publishing if audit shows max_mapped_id >= 65536.
ben: Agree. Assigning actions: revert done (ben), packer guard & tests (maria), repo scan follow-ups (sasha).
summary: Detected int4 tokenmap packer overflow: mapped ids >= 65536 wrapped into 16-bit storage producing null tokens in QWEN-int4 outputs. Team rolled back map, will add guards/tests, audit conversion tooling, and discuss longer-term vocab layout options.
